author: Kevin Kelly
short: Native music with player panels, playlists, queue tools, DJ controls, and daily checks.
description: Music search and playback inside Red using yt-dlp, FFmpeg, and native Discord voice with DAVE support. Includes direct play/skip/queue commands and matching slash controls. Joins your voice channel, or the available voice channel with the most people if you are not in voice. Disconnects after the queue is idle for 10 seconds. No Lavalink server is needed. Install PyNaCl>=1.5.0,<1.6 and davey>=0.1.6 once in Red's Python environment, plus FFmpeg, libopus, and Deno 2.3+ or Node.js 22+ in the Red container. Working voice libraries from Downloader remain supported. Unload Red's bundled Audio cog before loading AudioPlus. Optional owner-configured daily checks test silent YouTube playback in Discord and DM the configuring owner on failure, postponing existing voice sessions. Includes checked automatic player panels, seek and queue editing, saved member playlists/favorites, and opt-in DJ/vote policies with guided setup. Adds requester-only search selection, opt-in round-robin fair queues, and bounded artist-based autoplay. Owner-only audiorepair reinstalls missing, unimportable, or incompatible native voice libraries in Red's Python environment and verifies required APIs in a fresh process before a required restart. Native checks include Discord's cached library bindings and catch a missing davey.DAVE_PROTOCOL_VERSION before connecting. Daily failure alerts identify the failing stage and safe exception details; audiostatus retains the last monitored-server result after the probe disconnects.
install_msg: Read https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/audioplus/README.md before loading. Downloader installs yt-dlp and EJS. Native voice also requires PyNaCl>=1.5.0,<1.6 and davey>=0.1.6, installed once in Red's Python environment; cog updates keep existing voice libraries. Install FFmpeg, libopus, and a supported JavaScript runtime inside the Red container. If PyNaCl or davey cannot import or reports incompatible native APIs, the bot owner can run [p]audiorepair with voice disconnected. It repairs failing voice libraries in Red's Python environment; restart Red after the repair result, then run [p]audiostatus. Repair does not install FFmpeg, Opus, or a JavaScript runtime. Unload Red's bundled Audio cog first if loaded. Use [p]audiostatus to check local dependencies, then [p]play <query>. Play joins your voice channel, or the available channel with the most people, and leaves after the queue is idle for 10 seconds. For slash commands, the owner runs [p]slash enablecog audioplus and [p]slash sync after loading. Legacy [p]audio commands remain available. No Lavalink node is required. Optional: run [p]audiocheck enable in your server for daily checks at 09:00 America/Chicago and private failure alerts, then [p]audiocheck now for an immediate silent test.
end_user_data_statement: Preserves global legacy Lavalink settings, including the node password, in Red Config for rollback. Native playback does not use them. Optional daily checks store the configuring owner's Discord ID, test server/channel IDs, public video URL, local schedule, daily cursor, latest safe result, and pending failure DM/delivery state. Recipient user-data hooks export or delete that monitor record and disable checking; already delivered Discord DMs are not deleted. Queues, normal track metadata, request contexts, volume, repeat mode, and normal playback failures remain in memory. No signed playback URLs, listening histories, audio downloads, or yt-dlp caches are persisted. Guild settings also store music panel/DJ/vote preferences and member-specific playlists/favorites with source URLs and metadata. User-data hooks export/delete those collections. Resolved Stream objects are never persisted.
